title: Sales/CS intake sieve and deployability checklist for enterprise asks
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable intake 'sieve' and deployability checklist used by Sales and Customer Success to aggregate enterprise feature asks and produce an initial scoping readout for PM/Eng review.
background: Sales and CS frequently submit enterprise asks with varying levels of detail. PMs spend significant time clarifying basics (impact, compliance, infra needs) before scoping. We need a fast, standardized first-pass that balances econ, technical complexity, and regulatory signals so that high-value asks surface quickly and low-viability asks are deprioritized without heavy PM/Eng investment.
goals: Enable Sales/CS to deliver a 10-minute initial scoping brief per request
Surface top 20% enterprise asks by expected ARR impact within one week
Reduce PM clarification cycle time from median 3 days to <24 hours for triage decisions
Provide a deployability score (1-5) combining infra, privacy, and implementation effort
acceptance_criteria: Checklist and intake form used in at least two pilot accounts in the next cycle
PM triage can make a go/no-go decision for 80% of items using checklist output alone
Artifacts from intake include: short problem statement, expected ARR band, deployability score, top 3 risks, and recommended next step
Checklist items map to Engineering/Privacy/Security signals for automatic routing
proposed_workflow: Sales/CS files intake via a short form (CRM or shared Airtable). The form populates an automated brief that includes economic bands, customer risk flags, required data residency or compliance, and a deployability matrix (dependencies, infra change estimate, SDK/API surface needed). PM reviews within 24 hours and either: 1) Fast-track to discovery (high-impact, high-deployability), 2) Schedule technical feasibility spike (high-impact, medium-deployability), or 3) Defer/close with rationale (low-impact or high-risk).
sieve_rules_summary: Weighted scoring: ARR proxy (40%), deployability (30%), strategic alignment (15%), customer concentration/account priority (10%), compliance overhead (penalty up to 25%). Items with composite score >= 70 -> discovery candidate; 45-69 -> feasibility spike; <45 -> require additional info or deprioritize.
deployability_checklist: Points to evaluate: (a) Does this require model changes vs config? (b) Sensitive data ingress or residency? (c) Real-time latency SLOs or batch processing? (d) Console/entitlement changes for customers? (e) Required runtime features (KV cache, custom batching, quantization profile)? (f) Estimated engineering weeks (S, M, L) and ops cadence (one-off, weekly, constant).
initial_analysis_examples: Example A: Customer requests lower-latency chat with custom session pinning — ARR band medium, deployability score 4 (config + routing changes), recommend discovery

Example B: Customer asks for on-prem model variants with HSM integration — ARR band high, deployability score 2 (requires Private deployment + KMS work), recommend scheduled feasibility + legal review
Example C: Feature parity for a niche embedding dimension — ARR band low, deployability score 5 (minor config), recommend backlog grooming
tasks: Draft short form template for Sales/CS (one page) and embed in our CRM - owner: Solutions Engineering
Build scoring spreadsheet and deployability rubric - owner: PM
Add automatic routing rules (privacy/security flags) to the intake pipeline - owner: Platform Eng
Pilot intake on three high-touch accounts for two weeks and collect feedback - owner: CS
Update PMT triage checklist with final scoring thresholds - owner: PM
